metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct session_skill for executing standardized model evaluation across multiple benchmarks (AlpacaEval 2, Arena-Hard, MT-Bench). It differs semantically and operationally from existing skills: not related to Maven repository configuration (Maven domain) or Next.js image optimization (web framework domain). Peer candidates (SimPO training skills and knowledge reference) are in different task_families (model_training vs. model_evaluation) and stages. The candidate has clear support evidence from SimPO documentation and represents a standalone evaluation workflow capability with no semantic overlap to existing registry entries.
